name: Mr. Sinister
caption: The alliance's own World Champion, defending against an allied promotion's challenger, who lost the title in a fast-count finish after a corrupt referee and the challenger's own allies interfered.

name: Ken Nemesis

tenures.source: Named as the alliance's own head of Council in a promotional announcement of 13 June 1999.

caption: The alliance's own head of Council, hosting a weekly open forum with its fans.

name: Dread Saxon
notes: The RSPWF Top 200's own 1998 entry (#87, tagged NWC) matches the alliance's own registry text naming this character among its recruitment-post wrestlers, and a served 2000 roleplay names him a two-time former alliance World Heavyweight Champion.
caption: A two-time former World Heavyweight Champion of the alliance, placing #87 in the RSPWF Top 200 for 1998, addressed by a challenger in 2000 as a fading legend.

tenures.source: Named in the alliance's own served roleplay as a two-time former alliance World Heavyweight Champion, addressed there as a fading legend by a challenger.

name: Hyuk Suh Kim
notes: The RSPWF Top 200's own tags (1999: #19, tagged NeWA, IWA, GCW; 2000: #147, tagged NWC) match the alliance's own served roleplay exactly: the handler's own introduction names a year running the same character first in NeWA and now in the alliance.
caption: A martial artist who carried his career from the National e-Wrestling Alliance into the alliance, placing #19 in the RSPWF Top 200 for 1999 and #147 for 2000.

tenures.source: A martial-artist character billed in his own words as running for a year, first in NeWA and now in the alliance, in a roleplay against a two-time former alliance World Heavyweight Champion.

name: Andrew "The Hurricane" Pierce
notes: Known from one post to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (23 October 1998), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/nwc-andrew-the-hurricane-pierce-post-please-evaluate-critique-1998-10-23.html: Andrew 'The Hurricane' Pierce, in his Orlando nightclub, sneers at Ice and promises to crush, cube or powder her before the finals in Montreal.
caption: A cigar-smoking nightclub owner who says he will crush, cube or powder Ice, October 1998.

identity.note: Recorded distinct, not merged: the name matches these held entities, but the page this record rests on (read whole) gives no receipt that ties it to any of them (a different fed, date or description). Reopenable the moment either side gains a record the other can be checked against.
